feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 August 2026 4:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 06 August 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High to the south of Ireland with an associated ridge covering the area. Low pressure areas to the southeast of Iceland and over Scandinavia.


##Wind##

West or west-northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the east of the area at first, then easing 3 or 4 late morning, but occasionally locally 5. Veering west or southwest late afternoon or early evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, soon backing mainly south-southwest 4 or 5.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
